settings.heading: Beauty held to a written standard.
settings.lede: Shoppers shouldn't need a chemistry degree to buy a moisturizer. So we wrote down what we accept, and every brand has to meet it.
settings.image_alt: Boutique wall of shelves above a fluted counter

settings.title: Ingredients that earn their place
settings.text: An in-house science team and outside advisors review each ingredient against the evidence and the rules in the region where it is sold.

settings.title: Less waste by design
settings.text: Guidelines push brands toward recycled and renewable materials and designs that can really be recycled.

settings.title: Fair sourcing
settings.text: We ask for traceable supply chains and fair labor, including for mined minerals such as mica.

settings.title: No animal testing, lower impact
settings.text: Cruelty-free comes first. Beyond that we track our own emissions and expect proof behind sustainability claims.

settings.heading: Required and encouraged
settings.lede: A brand must clear every required item to be listed. Encouraged items win it a place in our spotlight.

settings.title: Product
settings.required: Full disclosure of ingredients under standard names. Warning before any formula change. Compliance with local law. Stability, preservative and compatibility tests. Skin patch testing on new launches. Heavy-metal, PFAS and asbestos checks where relevant. Batch traceability. Evidence behind every claim.
settings.encouraged: Factories that follow good manufacturing practice. Accredited labs. Open fragrance disclosure. Sourcing notes. Organic certification.

settings.title: Packaging
settings.required: Follow our packaging guidelines. Limit single-use parts. At least half recycled plastic where plastic is used. Disposal directions on pack. Resin codes. Certified paper. Accurate recycling claims.
settings.encouraged: Join the packaging collective. Offer refills. Raise recycled content further.

settings.title: People
settings.required: A supplier code of conduct covering fair pay and safe workplaces. Traceability for high-risk materials.
settings.encouraged: Third-party labor audits. Programs that support suppliers' communities.

settings.title: Planet
settings.required: No animal testing at any stage. A written position on raw material sourcing.
settings.encouraged: Climate targets. Lower-impact materials. Public reports on progress.

settings.title: Request the technical standard
settings.text: Brands ask for the long-form document and a checklist.

settings.title: Submit every ingredient list
settings.text: We review all products, not a sample.

settings.title: Resolve flags
settings.text: Where something is restricted, we agree a reformulation plan.

settings.title: Go on the shelf
settings.text: Approved items get a standard card on their product page.

settings.heading: Marks you will see on product pages
settings.lede: Each shows an extra commitment, and appears only when it is true.
